'''Tobar Ka-Teen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].

==Biography==
A [[Jedi]], Tobar Ka-Teen was philosophy-minded and made several investigations into the nature of the truth and what constituted it. After becoming a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], Ka-Teen had a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] placed on his head by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] after a mission to [[Kriost Station]] interrupted one of their operations. Captured by a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] called [[Kallyx/Legends|Kallyx]] the Piner, Ka-Teen was tortured by Kallyx' knives for weeks. Questioned about Jedi secrets, Ka-Teen found a capacity of lying during his time with Kallyx, and never revealed anything. Describing his technique as "the abandonment of truth," Ka-Teen successfully deceived Kallyx and he was eventually rescued by a Jedi strike team.<ref name="NoP" />

Regarded as a hero by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|High Council]], Ka-Teen became withdrawn and prone to studying within the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Archives]] of the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] for long hours alone. Ka-Teen began searching for the elemental truth, the fundamental constitution behind the concept of being honest. This search brought him to the [[Crown of Verity/Legends|Crown of Verity]], an ancient [[Benetage/Legends|Benetagean]] artifact kept within the Temple's Archives. Making many studies of the artifact, Ka-Teen pondered the [[Vergence/Legends|vergence]] on the [[planet]] [[Auratera/Legends|Auratera]] and its effects on the crown. Refusing to take the rank of [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] within the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Ka-Teen was permitted by the High Council to take the Crown of verity to [[Acablas/Legends|Acablas]] on Auratera and conduct an investigation. Escorted by Republic troops to the site, Ka-Teen was on the world when [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|Contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was enacted and Ka-Teen was assumed to have been killed. Ka-Teen, the Crown, and the clone troopers were never seen again.<ref name="NoP" />
